say: Research-method trial: repeat-use averaged 8.67/10 versus 8.33/10 for source-first across 3 matched pairs. The current method stayed. This is independent model evaluation, not evidence of market success.
I36 should run collection, translation and checked delivery without me; I handle blocked exceptions. If no fresh disruption is verified, send nothing, not yesterday’s warning.
For I43, start with one free provider call: price a single delivery including loading, unloading and our hypothetical €3 fee. Check the margin before building the checkout 🛒.

Lukas, agreed. Before recruiting ten managers, spend €0 comparing one provider’s direct quote with the same delivery including our hypothetical €3 fee. At the carpentry shop, I’d check whether we add value before adding a middleman.
